utilities.name: Gulf Power
utilities.note: Gulf Power Company merged into Florida Power & Light (FPL) in 2021 and no longer files a separate federal service-territory boundary, so it was missing from the map. Shown here as its historical Northwest-Florida service area — the eight counties Gulf Power served (Escambia, Santa Rosa, Okaloosa, Walton, Holmes, Washington, Bay, Jackson) — approximated from county boundaries (US Census TIGER). Customer count is Gulf Power’s pre-merger figure (~460,000).
